correctness.rationale: The statement defines exact graph orders, Hamiltonian, infinite-time normalization and all Fourier indices. In the proof, the normalized character sum gives rho=equal-energy ordered-pair count/(nq). Same-band solutions are exactly n,1,2,0 according to parity; the algebraic-integer norm argument exhausts all possible q>=3 cross-band differences with q3 and q4, including both orientations. Matrix spectral correction and rank follow characterwise. An independent eigenspace-projector implementation checked 84 graph cases, 4389 modes and 296709 entries with worst matrix difference 1.11e-15; it is corroboration, not an infinite proof. Small-order exceptions are excluded from the theorem domain.

Originality is a scoped evidence judgment, not a claim of an exhaustive novelty oracle.

value.rationale: Time averaging of a Cartesian quantum walk need not factor. This exact natural family classification isolates two arithmetic resonance families and distinguishes spectral changes invisible to rank from a sharp, parameter-specific three-mode revival (n=2 mod 4,q=4). The exact rational spectrum and positive-semidefinite product correction quantify the phenomenon across infinitely many cycles and all clique widths, providing a motivated invariant beyond routine parameter substitution.
